The '''Quasar Fire-class bulk freighter''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] purchased several freighters at auction and then transported them to hidden Rebel [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], where they were dismantled and reconstructed as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] over a span of several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] and renamed as [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|Quasar Fire-class bulk cruiser]].<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Quasar Fire-class bulk freighter was first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] series.<ref name="Target" />
